children: Tesla and SpaceX formed board committees to discuss a possible merger. Barclays estimates Musk would hold 37% of the combined equity and 56% of voting power; shareholder approval may be required.
Elon Musk confirmed Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX are weighing a merger, with no terms agreed. SpaceX’s government contracts and Tesla’s China operations may pose regulatory hurdles.
Tesla’s 2025 pay plan lets Elon Musk earn stock awards tied to market-cap milestones in a change-of-control deal, without meeting operational targets. The first milestone is a $2 trillion valuation.
Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) lowered its annual capital expenditure forecast by 20% and reported positive free cash flow in the third quarter. Spending on AI and robotics came in below analysts’ expectations.
Tesla faces a planned South Korean complaint over marketing FSD to buyers of ineligible cars. The regulator is investigating; only about 20% of local Teslas can use the software.
Tesla sold 67,829 China-made Model 3 and Model Y vehicles in October, up 10.3% year over year but down 28.9% from September—its lowest monthly total since February.
Analyst Gary Black warned a stock-funded Tesla–SpaceX merger could dilute TSLA holders and expose them to price swings. He said a deal could take years to complete.
Tesla’s October registrations rose year over year in Sweden (248%), Norway (131%), Denmark (34%), Spain (271%), Portugal (186%) and Italy (94%). It led Norway with 9.8% market share.
Tesla expanded its Robotaxi service to Fort Worth, adding to Austin, Dallas and Houston. Tesla did not disclose fleet size, pricing, or whether Fort Worth and Dallas service areas are connected.
Tesla’s Full Self-Driving system won approval in Latvia, its 10th EU market. Italy’s transport minister also backed swift EU approval of the driver-assistance technology.
